```{r}
llm_alldata <- read_excel("D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/M_rater_all_data.xlsx")

Gender_ID <- read_excel("D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/HC_Gender.xlsx")

Group_ID <- read_excel("D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/MDD_HC_ID.xlsx")


```

```{r}
# 转义正则特殊字符，避免Sub_ID中若含有. ( ) 等符号时被误解析
escape_ids <- function(ids) {
  str_replace_all(ids, "([\\.\\^\\$\\|\\(\\)\\[\\]\\{\\}\\*\\+\\?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
}

# 用Group_ID的Sub_ID筛选
# Sub_ID开头是数字的（如"5_sub001_MDD"）：Participant_ID只要包含该Sub_ID即保留
# Sub_ID开头是"S"的（如"Sub001"）：只保留Participant_ID以该Sub_ID + "_S1D1"开头的行（如"Sub001_S1D1*"）
group_ids_digit <- Group_ID$Sub_ID[str_detect(Group_ID$Sub_ID, "^[0-9]")]
group_ids_s     <- Group_ID$Sub_ID[!str_detect(Group_ID$Sub_ID, "^[0-9]")]

digit_pattern <- paste(escape_ids(group_ids_digit), collapse = "|")
s_pattern     <- paste0("^(", paste(escape_ids(group_ids_s), collapse = "|"), ")_S1D1")

llm_alldata_group <- llm_alldata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Participant_ID, digit_pattern) |
         str_detect(Participant_ID, s_pattern))

# 用Gender_ID的Sub_ID筛选，只要Participant_ID包含其中任意一个Sub_ID即保留
gender_pattern <- paste(escape_ids(Gender_ID$Sub_ID), collapse = "|")

llm_alldata_gender <- llm_alldata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Participant_ID, gender_pattern))
```

```{r}
# 对llm_alldata_gender中Participant_ID以"1"开头的行，只保留第10-13个字符为"E1S2"的行
# 不以"1"开头的行不受此限制，保持不变
llm_alldata_gender <- llm_alldata_gender %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Participant_ID, "^1") |
         substr(Participant_ID, 10, 13) == "E1S2")
```

```{r}
# 额外补充4个特定session的行（不受上面E1S2限制），合并进llm_alldata_gender
extra_ids_gender <- c("1_sub030_E1S3", "1_sub016_E2S2", "1_sub028_E2S2", "1_sub015_E2S3")

extra_pattern_gender <- paste0("^(", paste(escape_ids(extra_ids_gender), collapse = "|"), ")")

llm_alldata_extra_gender <- llm_alldata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Participant_ID, extra_pattern_gender))

llm_alldata_gender <- bind_rows(llm_alldata_gender, llm_alldata_extra_gender) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
# 额外补充6个特定session的行（不受上面_S1D1限制），合并进llm_alldata_group
extra_ids <- c("Sub023_S1D2", "Sub107_S1D2", "Sub607_S1D2",
               "Sub608_S1D2", "Sub626_S1D2", "Sub020_S2D1")

extra_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(escape_ids(extra_ids), collapse = "|"), ")")

llm_alldata_extra <- llm_alldata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Participant_ID, extra_pattern))

llm_alldata_group <- bind_rows(llm_alldata_group, llm_alldata_extra) %>%
  distinct()
```


```{r}
# 根据Participant_ID反查其对应的被试编号（Sub_ID），写入新列
# 逻辑：Group_ID$Sub_ID / Gender_ID$Sub_ID 中的每个值本身就是Participant_ID中
# 可以找到的一段子串（无论是数字开头的"5_sub001_MDD"这种完整编号，
# 还是"S"开头的"Sub001"这种基础编号，包括各自的extra补充行也都对应
# 这两份名单里已有的Sub_ID），因此按长度从长到短排序后做一次性的正则
# 提取，就能唯一确定每行文本所属的被试编号，且不会被更短的编号误匹配
extract_sub_id <- function(participant_ids, sub_id_list) {
  candidates <- sub_id_list[order(-nchar(sub_id_list))]
  pattern <- paste0("(", paste(escape_ids(candidates), collapse = "|"), ")")
  str_extract(participant_ids, pattern)
}

llm_alldata_group <- llm_alldata_group %>%
  mutate(Sub_ID = extract_sub_id(Participant_ID, Group_ID$Sub_ID)) %>%
  relocate(Sub_ID, .after = Participant_ID)

llm_alldata_gender <- llm_alldata_gender %>%
  mutate(Sub_ID = extract_sub_id(Participant_ID, Gender_ID$Sub_ID)) %>%
  relocate(Sub_ID, .after = Participant_ID)

# 检查是否存在未能匹配到被试编号的行，理论上应均为0
sum(is.na(llm_alldata_group$Sub_ID))
sum(is.na(llm_alldata_gender$Sub_ID))
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(llm_alldata_group, "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/llm_alldata_group.xlsx")
write_xlsx(llm_alldata_gender, "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/llm_alldata_gender.xlsx")
```
